target.title: fix(workspaces): reject raw file binding pointers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users reading workspace Markdown or CSV file bindings with a JSON pointer could receive the full raw file even when the pointer selected a missing non-root value.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Workspaces file-binding resolver now applies the same pointer contract at the raw-text owner boundary: omitted or root pointers return the file content, malformed pointers raise the existing invalid-binding error, and syntactically valid non-root pointers raise the existing not-found error. This covers the `.md` and `.csv` raw-text micro-cluster without changing JSON pointer handling, configuration, schema, storage schema, or provider behavior.

## User Impact

Workspace data reads for `file:<path>#<pointer>` now give a clear binding error for unsupported raw-text member lookups instead of treating a missing Markdown or CSV pointer as a successful full-file read.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Markdown and CSV workspace file bindings preserve no-pointer/root-pointer reads and reject non-root raw-text pointers instead of silently returning the full file.
- Current-head real behavior proof at `ae307c93070ebe7d8914b9ee3126e26f64a962f6`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` executed the production `createWorkspaceTools -> workspace_data_read.execute -> resolveBinding -> file binding under workspaces/data` path.

```json
{
  "head": "ae307c93070ebe7d8914b9ee3126e26f64a962f6",
  "proofPath": "createWorkspaceTools -> workspace_data_read.execute -> resolveBinding -> file binding under workspaces/data",
  "files": [
    "workspaces/data/notes.md",
    "workspaces/data/table.csv"
  ],
  "cases": [
    {
      "label": "markdown omitted pointer",
      "ok": true,
      "data": "# Notes\n"
    },
    {
      "label": "markdown root pointer",
      "ok": true,
      "data": "# Notes\n"
    },
    {
      "label": "markdown non-root pointer",
      "ok": false,
      "code": "binding_not_found",
      "message": "JSON pointer not found"
    },
    {
      "label": "csv non-root pointer",
      "ok": false,
      "code": "binding_not_found",
      "message": "JSON pointer not found"
    },
    {
      "label": "markdown malformed pointer",
      "ok": false,
      "code": "binding_invalid",
      "message": "JSON pointer is invalid"
    }
  ]
}
```

- Focused regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/workspaces/src/data-read.test.ts -- -t "applies pointers to JSON and raw text files"` passed with 1 test file, 1 selected test passed, and 6 skipped.
- Branch diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD -- extensions/workspaces/src/data-read.ts extensions/workspaces/src/data-read.test.ts` passed.
- Review proof: Codex autoreview through the configured `pixel_api` relay returned `findings: []` and `overall_correctness: "correct"` for the final PR diff.
- Duplicate search: open self PRs had no `extensions/workspaces` overlap, and live searches for `workspaces file binding pointer`, `workspace_data_read pointer`, `extensions/workspaces data-read pointer`, and `WorkspaceBindingResolutionError pointer` returned no overlapping open or closed PRs/issues.
- Observed result: the actual `workspace_data_read` tool path now returns Markdown content for omitted and empty pointers, returns `binding_not_found` for `/missing` on Markdown and CSV files, and returns `binding_invalid` for malformed raw-text pointers.
